906651.rationale: Josh Kerr (PB 3:45.34) has announced a WR attempt ('Project 222') in the Emsley Carr Mile at London on Jul 18 with pacers and custom Brooks spikes. He had not raced a mile or 1500m in 2026 as of Jun 20. He would need about 2.2s off his PB, and the 3:43.13 record (1999) has survived Ingebrigtsen's 3:43.73.
906651.next_info: Kerr's tune-up races (if any), the London field announcement (early-mid Jul), Pre Classic Bowerman Mile Jul 4, Monaco Jul 10; race Jul 18.

45561.rationale: England won the last four CWG men's team titles. Its 2026 squad is weaker than usual (Whitlock, Whitehouse, Tobin, Nathan, Yolshin-Cash; no Jarman, Fraser or Hepworth) but should still be favoured over Canada (Dolci, Emard, etc.).
45561.next_info: Canada/Scotland/Australia squad announcements (late Jun-Jul); injuries; team final Jul 24 (Emirates Arena).

970163.rationale: Pathirage is the 2026 world leader (92.62 in Rome, won Doha with 88.68) and Peters has been consistent (86.08 win in Rabat, 86.38 2nd in Doha). Neeraj returned with 85.69 and often throws big in qualifying. Arshad has not competed in 2026.
970163.next_info: Paris DL Jun 28, Monaco Jul 10, London Jul 18 javelin results; Arshad's first 2026 competition; CWG entry lists; qualification ~Jul 29-30.

449245.rationale: Same field as the qualification question. Pathirage is in the best form (two DL wins), followed by Peters and the returning Neeraj. Arshad (2022 champion, 90.18) has not competed yet and his fitness is unknown.
449245.next_info: July DL javelin results (Paris Jun 28, Monaco, London); Arshad comeback; final ~Jul 31.

777991.rationale: Harris is the 2025 world champion (24.02) and has the 2026 world-leading 24.08 (Aus Trials, Jun 13). Shayna Jack is skipping Pan Pacs. The US roster was picked from 2025 results: Walsh (2025 WL 23.91) and Huske (23.98) were both ill at the 2025 Worlds. No China or Europe at Pan Pacs (Irvine, Aug 12-15).
777991.next_info: US Nationals late Jul (form of Walsh/Huske), Harris at CWG (Glasgow late Jul), Pan Pacs event entries early Aug.

985937.rationale: Ledecky (WR 8:04.12) beat McIntosh (PB 8:05.07) by 1.7s at the 2025 Worlds. McIntosh is skipping CWG to focus on Pan Pacs and beat Ledecky in a 400 free in 2026. Pallister is a distant third.
985937.next_info: Canadian Trials (Jul): McIntosh 800 time/event choice; US Nationals late Jul; Pan Pacs entries/schedule (Aug 12-15).

22056.rationale: Rai Benjamin is skipping the hurdles in 2026. Dos Santos is unbeaten and has beaten Warholm three times (Keqiao 300H, Xiamen 46.72 WL, Oslo 46.89). Warholm is the main threat, and Silesia (Aug 23) comes after the Euros.
22056.next_info: Paris/Eugene/Monaco/London 400H results; European Champs Aug 10-16; Silesia start list ~Aug 18-21.

354508.rationale: Alfred is dominant in 2026 (10.76w win in Oslo, beat Jefferson-Wooden over 200m in Rome). Jefferson-Wooden is the 2025 world 100/200 champion. Entrants are unknown.
354508.next_info: Head-to-heads at Eugene Jul 4, Monaco, London; CWG (Alfred); Silesia start list ~Aug 18-21.

2260.rationale: The elite field had not been announced as of Jun 24. Organisers were chasing Sawe (1:59:30 London WR), Kejelcha (1:59:41) and Kiplimo. Kiros is the defending champion (2:06:06 course record). Probabilities are spread thin.
2260.next_info: Sydney elite field announcement (likely Jul); Berlin (Sep 27) and Chicago (Oct 11) field announcements show who is unavailable; race Aug 30.

409386.rationale: Hassan is the defending champion (2:18:22 in 2025) but withdrew from London 2026 with an Achilles injury, so a Sydney return is plausible but uncertain. The field is unannounced.
409386.next_info: Sydney elite field announcement (Jul); Hassan injury/comeback news; race Aug 30.

936021.rationale: Yihune won Xiamen (12:57) and Oslo (12:47.62 WL). The Ultimate Championship invites Olympic and world champions, the DL Final winner and top-ranked athletes (16 in the field). Ingebrigtsen's fitness and Hocker's form are unknown.
936021.next_info: DL 5000s (Paris, Eugene, London), Euros Aug 10-16, DL Final Brussels Sep 4-5, UC entry lists ~early Sep; final Sep 11.

261941.rationale: Yan Ziyi (CHN, 18) threw 71.74m in Xiamen, the second-best throw ever. Risks: she may skip the UC to focus on the Asian Games (Sep 19-Oct 4), and she has thrown little so far. The other names are established podium throwers.
261941.next_info: Yan's next competitions; DL Final Sep 4-5; UC entries; final Sep 12.

30434.rationale: Pathirage leads the 2026 season. Peters is consistent. Weber was the 2025 DL champion and tops the world rankings but has not been seen in 2026 results. Neeraj and Arshad are returning from injury. Walcott (2025 world champion) is off the list due to the 5-outcome cap.
30434.next_info: DL javelin results through Zurich (Aug 27), DL Final Sep 4-5, UC entries; final Sep 13.

653425.rationale: Lyles is the 2025 world 200m champion (won Rome 100m in 9.88). Tebogo is the Olympic champion (19.84 easing in Oslo). Gout Gout ran a 19.67 WU20 record in April but was 6th in his DL debut and focuses on World U20s in August.
653425.next_info: Eugene Jul 4 / Lausanne Aug 21 200m results, DL Final Sep 4-5, UC invitations; final Sep 13.

784475.rationale: 2026 half-marathon leaders: Chemnung 1:04:01 (Barcelona) and Gebreselama 1:04:48 (Lisbon, 2023 Worlds medallist). The Kenya and Ethiopia teams have not been named, and many stars may opt for autumn marathons.
784475.next_info: Kenyan/Ethiopian team selection (Jul-Aug); entry lists early Sep; race Sep 20.

518392.rationale: 2029 and 2031 are being awarded together in Sep 2026 (final bids due Aug 5). Bidders: London (government-backed but West Ham refuses September stadium use), Rome, Munich, Nairobi, Addis Ababa, Seoul, New Delhi.
518392.next_info: West Ham/London Stadium agreement news; Aug 5 final bid submissions; evaluation reports; WA Council meeting in September.

944956.rationale: Hamburg dropped out after its May 31 referendum (54.9% no). Munich (66.4% yes in 2025, existing venues) is seen as the favourite in a likely two-way race with KoelnRheinRuhr (66% yes, 14M tickets). Berlin held no referendum and is considered risky.
944956.next_info: DOSB evaluation commission recommendation (summer); extraordinary general assembly in Baden-Baden Sep 26 (42 Olympic federations x3 votes).

48050.rationale: The 2nd WHRG runs Aug 22-26 at the National Speed Skating Oval, and the 100m is now fully autonomous. Unitree H1 hit 10.1 m/s in an autonomous sprint (Apr 2026). Honor's Lightning ('Flash') swept the Apr 2026 robot half marathon. Tiangong Ultra won the 2025 WHRG 100m (21.50 with credit).
48050.next_info: WHRG entry lists and team announcements (Jul-Aug); any pre-Games sprint demos; race Aug 22.
